name: Omanoise
author: Joshua Doms
description: Procedural focus soundscapes in the bar. Sampled piano, harp, vibraphone and music box (libfluidsynth + FluidR3_GM) are sequenced Endel-style over PADsynth wavetable pads and a quiet noise bed — Focus and Relax — plus an Environment mode that blends six environments on their own sliders — a synthesized ocean and rain, and public-domain/CC0 recordings of a fireplace, wind, a stream and a dawn chorus, played as randomly scheduled segments with equal-power crossfades so nothing ever loops. Adapts to the time of day. Tuned for calm: attacks over 150 ms, major pentatonic only, and no periodic modulation anywhere in the audio path.

barWidget.description: Generative concentration soundscapes: play/pause, mode, a blendable ocean/rain/fire/wind/stream/birds environment, intensity, brightness, tonal balance, 16 Hz neural modulation, binaural beats and a stop-after timer.
